summary: The exact candidate is a valid narrow fix for Bug A: it requests RGB from the standard torchvision JPEG decoder, eliminating the grayscale one-channel tensor, mixed-stack failure, and 256-vs-768 Gemma-shaped projection failure. It does not change or verify Bug B, so it is a partial fix to the original issue rather than a full resolution.

tests.what_was_measured: Checked-out base _load_image passed no mode, returned grayscale/RGB shapes (1,48,64)/(3,48,64), failed mixed stacking, and produced the on-device gfx950 Linear(768,1152) error for 256-wide patches.
12 focused tests passed, including candidate grayscale-to-RGB, RGB, mixed-stack, fallback, and existing PIL cases.
Candidate passed ImageReadMode.RGB at the decode boundary, returned three channels for grayscale and RGB, and completed the gfx950 Gemma-shaped projection with output (12,1152).

tests.command: Independent inline boundary script using candidate common._load_image and BaseMultimodalProcessor._load_single_item
tests.what_was_measured: Grayscale, RGB, and CMYK JPEG inputs became (3,32,32) tensors; RGBA PNG became an RGB PIL image; the real CUDA/HIP torchvision JPEG call reported that nvJPEG support was not compiled.

tests.command: git diff --exit-code 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 cdc14d94a9d8efbb48b96910176cb11b1f14eb43 -- python/sglang/srt/multimodal/mm_utils.py python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py python/sglang/srt/models/gemma4_vision.py
tests.what_was_measured: No embedding, scheduler containment, per-request isolation, or Gemma vision guard source changed.

gpu_evidence: Torch reported AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. The base 256-wide patches failed an on-device Linear(768,1152), while candidate-normalized 768-wide patches produced (12,1152). The nvJPEG decoder itself could not run because this ROCm torchvision lacks nvJPEG support.
remaining_counterexamples: An unrelated or malformed multimodal encoder input can still raise through forward_batch_generation into the scheduler process exception handler and its parent SIGQUIT path.
A failing multimodal request in a mixed batch is not identified or selectively aborted; true per-request isolation remains absent.
The real nvJPEG implementation on NVIDIA hardware and full Gemma-4 2xH200 TP=2 serving path were not executable in this environment.
remaining_limitations: The installed ROCm torchvision 0.26.0+rocm7.2 is not compiled with nvJPEG support; decoder semantics were tested with a deterministic CPU decoder substitution at the checked-out call boundary.
Gemma-4 weights and the reported two-H200 topology were unavailable, so no full model, HTTP server, concurrent batch, or scheduler subprocess reproduction is claimed.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
